newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK STOCKS UP 0.24 PCT AT 1200 LOCAL (0900GMT).
newsitem.headline: GREEK STOCKS UP 0.24 PCT AT 1200 LOCAL (0900GMT).

text.p: The Athens bourse's general share index was up 0.24 percent or 3.55 points at 1,497.08 from Thursday's 1,493.53 at 1200 local (0900 GMT).
Banks and industrials were trading 0.44 and 0.13 percent higher, respectively.
A technical problem with the Athens stock exchnage feed has interrupted price and trading information. The problem is being worked on.
